name: plugin.memgraphrag
description: Three-layer memory knowledge graph engine with conflict-aware graph construction and hybrid PPR retrieval

entrypoints.name: memgraphrag_index
entrypoints.description: Ingest document passages, construct the 3-layer memory hierarchy, and build the retrieval graph

parameters.name: docs
parameters.description: List of text passage strings or document dict objects to index

parameters.name: save_dir
parameters.description: Output partition directory for memory persistence (default: 'outputs/default')

parameters.name: chunk_size
parameters.description: Token chunk size for passage splitting (default: 256)

parameters.name: chunk_overlap
parameters.description: Token overlap between consecutive passage chunks (default: 32)

parameters.name: skip_conflict_resolution
parameters.description: Bypass conflict detection and resolution if true (default: false)

entrypoints.name: memgraphrag_retrieve
entrypoints.description: Execute hybrid multi-layer graph retrieval combining dense similarity and Personalized PageRank

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Natural language query or question

parameters.name: save_dir
parameters.description: Partition directory to retrieve from (default: 'outputs/default')

parameters.name: num_to_retrieve
parameters.description: Maximum number of ranked evidence passages to return (default: 5)

parameters.name: damping
parameters.description: Damping factor for Personalized PageRank graph propagation (default: 0.5)

parameters.name: passage_node_weight
parameters.description: Multiplier weight for passage entity seeds during PPR (default: 0.1)

entrypoints.name: memgraphrag_query
entrypoints.description: Synthesize an answer using retrieved multi-layer knowledge graph evidence

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Question to answer using graph memory

parameters.name: save_dir
parameters.description: Partition directory to query (default: 'outputs/default')

parameters.name: num_passages
parameters.description: Number of candidate evidence passages to retrieve for synthesis (default: 5)

entrypoints.name: memgraphrag_add_passage
entrypoints.description: Incrementally inject a passage chunk and factual relation triples into the active memory graph

parameters.name: chunk_id
parameters.description: Unique passage chunk identifier

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Text content of the passage chunk

parameters.name: extracted_triples
parameters.description: Optional pre-extracted list of [head, relation, tail] triples

parameters.name: schema_tuple
parameters.description: Optional ontology schema [head_type, relation, tail_type]

parameters.name: save_dir
parameters.description: Partition directory (default: 'outputs/default')

entrypoints.name: memgraphrag_get_memory_summary
entrypoints.description: Inspect statistical distribution and count metrics for schema, fact, and passage layers

parameters.name: save_dir
parameters.description: Partition directory to summarize (default: 'outputs/default')

entrypoints.name: memgraphrag_detect_conflicts
entrypoints.description: Scan candidate facts for hard semantic contradictions with supporting passage evidence groups

parameters.name: save_dir
parameters.description: Target memory partition directory (default: 'outputs/default')
